_about: Public-domain John Clifford (1836-1923), General Baptist minister of Westbourne Park and first President of the Baptist World Alliance, for the Word Hoard: Hints on Bible Study, The Christian Certainties (1893), The Inspiration and Authority of the Bible (1892), Typical Christian Leaders (1898), Social Worship an Everlasting Necessity (1899), The Ultimate Problems of Christianity (1906), The Gospel of Gladness (1912) and The Gospel of World Brotherhood (1920). W. K. Clifford, on his own shelf, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
